sections.title: Reading — Task 1: Tasks
sections.instructions: Read the passage, then answer the questions.

questions.prompt: The graph below compares the number of visits to two new music sites on the web. Write a report for a university lecturer describing the information shown below. Write at least 150 words.

Adults do less exercise these days. Some people think that showing sports events on the television such as the Olympics and international tournaments is the best way to encourage adults to do exercise. Others believe there are more effective ways to do so. Discuss both views and give your opinion. Write at least 250 words. Cambridge IELTS Tests 1 to 17
